idea-plugin.name: RGC Language Support
idea-plugin.description:
RGC language support for JetBrains IDEs.

  • Registers the .rg file type and RGC language
  • Syntax highlighting is provided by the bundled TextMate grammar (see the repository textmate/ directory)

This plugin is a starting point for a full LSP-based plugin (completion, diagnostics, build/run actions). The RGC language server is started as rgc lsp --stdio.
